$comment: Every spoken and displayed line, keyed by id. tools/voice.mjs reads this file, resolves `voice` against the ElevenLabs voice list by NAME (no ids committed), and writes /audio/vo/<id>.mp3. It is idempotent: a line whose text hash is unchanged is skipped. The API key lives in ELEVENLABS_API_KEY and never reaches the client. If an mp3 is missing the game shows the subtitle and moves on.

voices.$comment: Set `name` to a voice in your ElevenLabs library. `voice.mjs --list` prints what your account has.

boot-1.text: Port Vantage. Nothing here is real, including the deadlines.

greeter-hello.speaker: mentor
greeter-hello.text: {name}. You actually came. Good — walk with me.

greeter-brief.speaker: mentor
greeter-brief.text: Five districts, one ring road, and a wanted level made entirely of meetings. Pick a ride at the crib garage.

greeter-quest.speaker: mentor
greeter-quest.text: Board, scooter, car, or subway. Explore if you want. The bright route gets you to the work.

garage-choice.speaker: mentor
garage-choice.text: Your commute has options. Board for shortcuts, scooter for side streets, car for distance — or take the train straight to the pin.

ride-board.speaker: mentor
ride-board.text: Low overhead. High ankle exposure. F kickflips when you're rolling. Space or E hops off.

ride-scooter.speaker: mentor
ride-scooter.text: Fast enough to matter, small enough to ignore parking. Space or E hops off.

ride-car.speaker: mentor
ride-car.text: Four doors, one destination. The map will reroute if you wander.

onboard-manager-call.speaker: manager
onboard-manager-call.text: First assignment: DEAL CLOCK at Vantage Plaza. I sent the route. The timer starts only when you accept.

subway-depart.speaker: transit
subway-depart.text: MISSION EXPRESS. Direct service. No transfers and, somehow, no reimbursement form.

subway-arrive.speaker: manager
subway-arrive.text: Downtown. The marker starts DEAL CLOCK. There is a loaner car by the lobby.

home-save.text: Saved. The apartment stays where you left it.

commuter-2.text: It's a five minute walk. It's always a five minute walk.

suit-1.text: Let's put some time on the calendar.

suit-3.text: Circling back on the circle back.

digger-3.text: I own this already. I'm buying it again.

raver-2.text: It's loud in the good way.

delegate-4.text: That one slide was the whole talk.

tailgate-1.text: Gates don't open for an hour.

pursuer-t1-b.text: Sorry to ping. Are you around?

pursuer-t1-c.text: Following up on my follow up.

pursuer-t2-a.text: I've put fifteen minutes on your calendar.

pursuer-t2-b.text: It's already declined. That's fine. I'll re-send.

pursuer-t2-c.text: Do you have a hard stop?

pursuer-t3-a.text: My skip is asking. That's all I'll say.

pursuer-t3-b.text: Pull over and we can align.

pursuer-t3-c.text: This would be a two-minute conversation.

pursuer-t4-b.text: We're just trying to get everyone in a room.

pursuer-t5-a.text: Legal would like to be looped in.

pursuer-t5-b.text: We're not saying stop. We're saying pause.

pursuer-t5-c.text: This is a process conversation, not a you conversation.

caught-2.text: You have been added to a working group.

repaint-1.text: Reply All Repaint. Fresh coat, clean thread, everyone removed.

m-deal-clock-start.speaker: manager
m-deal-clock-start.text: Four lobbies, one countdown. Every stop escalates you. Go.

m-deal-clock-win.speaker: manager
m-deal-clock-win.text: All four. The deal exists now, which is worse.

m-deal-clock-fail.speaker: manager
m-deal-clock-fail.text: Clock's out. It'll be on next quarter's roadmap.

m-crate-dig-start.text: Six records walked out of here. Find them and I'll unlock the good stations.

m-crate-dig-win.text: All six. Station's yours. Don't make it weird.

m-set-time-start.text: Booth's yours. Stay on the grid.

m-cold-boot-start.text: Sub-level. Raised floor, pressure sensors. Reach the terminal without lighting one.

m-cold-boot-trip.text: Sensor. Reset and try the other row.

m-shootout-start.text: Best of five. The keeper has a tell.

m-yard-run-start.text: Checkpoints through the yard. Ramps are load-bearing. Probably.

m-yard-run-win.text: Under time. The cranes are impressed.

m-escort-start.text: Airport road to The Heights. My passenger is nervous and reads the speedometer.

m-escort-fail.text: They asked to get out. The invite is already on the calendar.

m-escort-win.text: Door to door. No incident report.

m-blackout-start.text: Lights are out across all five. Everyone wants a word. Drive.

m-blackout-win.text: You lost them at the bridge. Power's back. Nobody will mention this again.

radio-id-wgrd.text: W-G-R-D. Ground Floor. Entry level, senior sound.

radio-id-kflp.text: K-F-L-P. Flip Side. We only play the edit.

radio-id-habi.text: Habibi Wave. Everything is a reissue and that is fine.

radio-id-mnfr.text: Mainframe F-M. Broadcasting from a basement with excellent cooling.

radio-id-tlkr.text: All-Talk Ten-Ten. You're on the air, and you're on mute.

radio-id-suns.text: Sunset Debenture. Soft rock for people with courtside seats.

ad-repaint.text: Got a thread you can't leave? Reply All Repaint. Two coats and everybody's off the chain.

ad-deli.text: Sunrise Deli. Bacon, egg and cheese. Four fifty. Cash. He's already making it.

ad-vantage.text: Vantage Group. We're not a company, we're a way of working. Legally we are also a company.

ad-consult.text: Is your transformation transforming? Ours transformed so hard it became a different transformation.

rewind-explain.text: Same seed, same policies, same sixty seconds. Watch what they decide, then watch how they get there. The decisions hold. The paths don't.

$signageComment: Text painted into the atlas for signs and billboards. Keep each short — these render at 64px.

billboards: WE ALIGNED SO YOU DON'T HAVE TO
